prompt: Write a three paragraph biography for Australian Film Producer Drew Bailey, list his oscar nominated film and his time as an assistant director.
response: Drew Bailey is an Australian film producer known for his work on the Oscar-nominated film "Lion" (2016), directed by Garth Davis. Prior to producing, Bailey worked as an assistant director on several high-profile films, including "The Great Gatsby" (2013) and "Mad Max: Fury Road" (2015). He has been recognized for his contributions to the film industry, and continues to produce films that explore diverse and compelling stories.
